confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the supplied comparables; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors are moderately reliable. Hostel and hotel rates vary widely by neighborhood, season and room type, so they are less certain. Cocktail and wine are the least certain: they were set from the usual local price relationship to draught beer rather than from direct price knowledge. The FX value comes from a web search result that attributes the 14 October 2026 4 pm RBA reading to the RBA statistics page; that page itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: Calibrated between the supplied Lima and Cartagena observations for beer, coffee, inexpensive meals, mid-range meals and basic hotel rooms; hostel rooms and the three-star hotel sit nearer the Cartagena and Buenos Aires levels. Buenos Aires was given less weight for restaurant anchors because its restaurant prices are far higher than the other comparables.
